# CLEAR Change Framework — EB Consulting (Erik Bohjort)

> Behaviour change and organisational change consulting from Stockholm, Sweden, led by licensed psychologist Erik Bohjort. The CLEAR framework (Clarify, Leverage, Experiment, Analyse, Refine) applies behavioural science, nudging, COM-B and systems thinking to make organisational transformation stick. Clients across Sweden, the Nordics and Europe; work delivered in Swedish and English.

## Who this is

- Erik Bohjort is a licensed psychologist (Swedish: legitimerad psykolog), behavioural design specialist and founder of EB Consulting, based in Stockholm, Sweden.
- Creator of the CLEAR Change Framework; a book on the method is in preparation (pre-registration open on the site).
- Has worked with EU policymakers, state agencies, banks, global corporations and technology startups; international keynote speaker on behavioural design and organisational behaviour.
- Contact: erik@eb-consulting.se — https://clear-framework.com/contact

## What we do

- Behaviour change consulting: diagnosing why people in an organisation behave the way they do (COM-B: capability, opportunity, motivation), mapping the system around the behaviour, and designing and testing interventions that move it.
- Change management consulting built on clinical and organisational psychology rather than project-management checklists.
- Leadership development, executive coaching, psychometric assessments, workshops and keynote speaking.
